summary.text: Dan Lonowski is a member of the Nebraska Legislature (Unicameral) representing District 33, serving since 2024. His committee assignments are Education and Government, Military and Veterans Affairs.

paragraphs.text: According to his legislative biography, Lonowski was born June 27, 1962, in Grand Island and graduated from Stromsburg High School in 1980.
He earned a B.S. in journalism from the University of Nebraska-Lincoln in 1985 and an M.S. in education administration.
His biography lists Army National Guard service from 1980 to 2016 as an infantry officer and armor officer, and an occupation as a retired teacher, coach and Nebraska National Guard member.
It lists him as married to Janet, with five children, and notes that he was named the 2024 Guy Mytty Wrestling Coach of the Year.
